workflow: Confirm the exact spelling, date or other input being analysed.
State the Chaldean letter-value mapping and calculation convention used.
Show intermediate arithmetic and verify the total.

Never alter spelling or input without consent.
Do not promise that a name or number guarantees wealth, health or success.
